thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 page — high tail latency observed on inference cluster in us-west-2. Avg p95 token latency > 1200ms for /v1/generate. Paging oncall rotation: Maya (primary).
Maya (oncall): I'm on it. Looking at dashboard now — p95 spiking across both scale groups. /api/metrics shows request queue depth rising.
Maya (oncall): Quick check: any deploys in last 30m? @Ravi or @Liam?
Ravi: No deploys from infra. I see a sudden growth in long polling requests from a single customer org (org_id: org-824). Possibly a bad job.
Liam: Can you pull traces? I'll try to route a canary to a smaller model to see if latency drops.
Maya (oncall): Running trace: `/traces?service=inference&span=kv-cache` — lots of retries on remote KV store. ops-bot: KV store error rate at 5% for us-west-2.
ops-bot: Alert created: KV-THROUGHPUT-DEGRADATION-1782507890 — linked to this thread.
Tara: Paging database oncall to confirm: @Sophie are you able to take a look at the redis cluster?
Sophie: On it. I already see intermittent 500-levels from the managed redis cluster — eviction pressure + connection churn. Investigating slow queries.
Maya (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) divert heavy org traffic to degraded-model fallback 2) disable long-polling feature for the org 3) scale temporary read replicas for redis. Agree?
Ravi: +1 for diverting. I'll update the routing policy to prefer quantized-variant-3 for that org. Command: `./routing set-policy --org org-824 --model quant-variant-3 --priority=high`
Liam: I'll set up canary routing: `deploy canary --route /v1/generate --to quant-variant-3 --traffic 20%` — will monitor for 2min then bump.
Maya (oncall): Executed step 1. p95 dropped to ~650ms after 20% traffic shift. Continuing.
Sophie: Redis: temporarily increased maxclients and spun up an emergency replica. Evictions dropped. Connection errors falling.
Product - Ana: FYI a small subset of users reported degraded responses in the last 40m. Are we still having customer impact?
Maya (oncall): Customer impact: majority of traffic recovered after routing bump and redis replica. Affected window ~00:12 — 00:45 UTC. Estimated customers impacted: 1 major org (org-824) and 15% of served requests. No data loss.
Ravi: Logging timeline for post-incident notes. We're stabilised; planning handoff to night shift at 01:00 UTC.
Maya (oncall): Handoff prep: creating checklist and action items. I'll keep as primary until 01:00.
incident-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled at 00:58 UTC. Use `/handoff start` to capture live notes.
Maya (oncall): /handoff start — summary: root cause likely a sudden increase in long-lived connections from org-824 causing redis eviction and elevated KV errors. Mitigations applied: routing diversion, temporary redis replica, evictions tuned.
Tara: Agreed root cause. Action items:
- A1: Throttle long-polling per-org defaults (owner: Ravi) — due in 24h
- A2: Improve redis autoscale policy + runbook (owner: Sophie) — due in 72h
- A3: Add routing automatic fallback to quantized variants on backend error (owner: Liam) — due 48h
- A4: Postmortem + customer comms draft (owner: Maya, co-owner: Ana) — schedule within 48h
Maya (oncall): I'll create the initial postmortem doc and ping customer success for coordinated comms.
Sophie: I'll start a branch for runbook changes. Proposed snippet to add to oncall runbook under "Cache-tier failures":
```
- symptoms: increased p95 token latency + KV errors
- triage steps:
  1) check ops-bot KV error alerts
  2) identify offending org by request signature
  3) toggle per-org long-polling to off: `admin set-feature --org <org> --feature long_polling --off`
  4) scale read replicas: `infra scale redis --replicas +1`
- mitigation temp fixes: route to quantized model variant, increase maxclients
```
Ravi: Suggest we also add a quick command to the runbook to temporarily reduce per-org connection limit: `admin set-limits --org <org> --connections 50` — saves ops time.
Liam: For incident command updates: recommend adding an explicit step to call customer success within 30m of stabilization for P0s where a customer is directly implicated.
Maya (oncall): All good. I'm scheduling the postmortem doc: https://redwood.docs/pmo/1782507890 (draft). Will assign action items there.
Product - Ana: I'll be on the postmortem and help draft comms. Please tag me when doc is ready.
incident-bot: Postmortem due-by reminder created (48h). Owner: Maya.
Maya (oncall): Handoff: @Tara will be secondary oncall from 01:00; I'll drop out at 01:05. Key notes copied to rotation log.
Tara: Taking over. Thanks @Maya. I'll watch the routing and redis metrics for the next 2h.
Ravi: Quick retro note — we should update alert thresholds to reflect failure modes where queue depth climbs before error rate spikes.
Sophie: I'll prepare a PR to the runbook with the cache-tier section and the command snippets. Ping me to review.
Liam: I'll follow up on automation for fallback routing (A3). Planning spike tomorrow.
Maya (oncall): Closing thread for now — incident stabilised, mitigations applied, postmortem scheduled. Please add any missed items here.
Ana: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone for the quick coordination — good call on routing fallback.
ops-bot: Incident closed by Maya at 01:07 UTC. Link to timeline: https://ops.redwood/incidents/1782507890/timeline
